title: Manchester United: Hall Hunt and Gusto Tussle Show a Club in a Hurry
body:
Manchester United are reportedly set to revive their interest in Newcastle defender Lewis Hall, though they may struggle to prise him away [S1]. The same round-up has Manchester United and Manchester City going head-to-head for Chelsea defender Malo Gusto [S2], while Leeds United are pursuing Will Lankshear [S2]. Arsenal midfielder Martin Zubimendi is reportedly pondering his future [S1], and Chelsea are said to be eyeing a double swoop for two Barcelona players [S1].

Their last five league matches brought no wins, three draws and two defeats, earning 3 points from 6 goals scored and 11 conceded [ST1]. Newcastle have fared only slightly better, with one win, one draw and three defeats from their last five, taking 4 points while scoring 4 and conceding 7 [ST2]. [ST1] [ST2]

Neither side is in the kind of form that makes a headline signing a quick fix, and the goals-against column tells its own story. A team leaking that many chances needs a plan, not a shopping list of shiny names.

The smart money is on patience, because rushed deals rarely age well. Talk is cheap until the paperwork is signed, so treat every rumour with a healthy dose of scepticism.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
